description: Java class demonstrating external storage handling in Android, including creating, deleting, and checking files in public and private external storage directories, as well as monitoring external storage state.

classes.name: ExternalStorage
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating interaction with external storage.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Helper class holding references to layout elements for storage controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up storage controls, and registers storage status monitoring.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters storage monitors.

methods.name: handleExternalStorageState
methods.description: Updates UI based on storage availability and writability.

methods.name: updateExternalStorageState
methods.description: Checks current external storage state and updates internal flags.

methods.name: startWatchingExternalStorage
methods.description: Registers receivers to monitor external storage mount/unmount events.

methods.name: createExternalStoragePublicPicture
methods.description: Creates and copies a picture resource into external public storage, and informs media scanner.

methods.name: hasExternalStoragePublicPicture
methods.description: Checks if the public picture file exists.

methods.name: createExternalStoragePrivatePicture
methods.description: Creates and copies a picture to private external storage.

methods.name: hasExternalStoragePrivatePicture
methods.description: Checks if the private picture file exists.

methods.name: createExternalStoragePrivateFile
methods.description: Creates a private external storage file and copies resource data into it.

methods.name: hasExternalStoragePrivateFile
methods.description: Checks for the existence of the private external file.

methods.name: createStorageControls
methods.description: Inflates and initializes UI controls for storage actions.
